name: diagram-studio
description: Design diagrams with Claude: Azure architectures in Microsoft Azure Architecture Center style with the official icons (/diagram-studio:azure), Databricks lakehouses, deployments and platform maps in the Databricks brand look (/diagram-studio:databricks), business diagrams such as operating models, swimlanes, roadmaps, value chains, 2x2s and layered architectures, and consulting-style data exhibits with bar charts, waterfalls, line charts and KPIs (/diagram-studio:business), and whole decks built from any of these (/diagram-studio:deck). Compare concepts on a live preview board, refine by conversation, then export PowerPoint, draw.io, SVG, PNG or PDF.
